title: What AWS provides
summary: Amazon Web Services offers rented computing and storage. You choose services for a job and pay according to their rules and usage.
introduction: Amazon Web Services offers rented computing and storage. You choose services for a job and pay according to their rules and usage. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Amazon Web Services offers rented computing and storage. You choose services for a job and pay according to their rules and usage.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: All examples are read-only worked plans. No AWS account, card, keys or deployed resources are needed to learn here. A real deployment is a separate authorised task.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of AWS. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.

blocks.code:

Possible parts: object storage and a content delivery service
Practice today: draw the plan only
blocks.title: What AWS provides

blocks.text: A static page does not need a running application server just because it is hosted in the cloud.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
List which files a static page needs.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Cloud resources can cost money even while you are learning; this course creates none.
For more detail later, use this [AWS further reading](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/introduction.html).
